# Graphs with no net force

<!-- STEP id="rest" -->
When no net force acts, there are two possibilities. If the object is at rest, its position does not change. Its position-time graph is a flat line, and its velocity stays zero.

<!-- STEP id="moving" -->
If the object moves with a constant velocity, its position-time graph is a straight line that rises steadily. Its velocity-time graph is a flat line above the time axis.
